titulo: Tema de Dex / exterior de AdrianLAB
escenas: (motivo de Dex para todo el juego)
prompt: Whimsical, sunny theme for a 1990s point-and-click adventure game: a curious young hero arrives at a quirky laboratory. Catchy, hummable clarinet melody that is easy to whistle, playful pizzicato strings, marimba and glockenspiel, upright bass, brushed drums. High-quality General MIDI orchestral sound, light and bouncy. 90 BPM, D major, 4/4. Instrumental only, seamless loop.

A.descripcion: calm: clarinet states the main melody over pizzicato strings and marimba, sparse brushed drums, relaxed and curious

B.descripcion: more energy: same melody played by the full ensemble with a small brass section answering, bouncier bass and drums, glockenspiel sparkles, cadence back to D major so it loops
